_readme: Mainnet launch settings. Every empty string and every value marked in _todo is the owner's decision. Read by `pnpm --filter @agents/runtime solana:mainnet preflight|platform`. Nothing here is a secret: keypairs are referenced by path and stay outside the repo.
_todo: multisig.address: the Squads v4 multisig, created first (see docs/MAINNET-LAUNCH.md step 2)

deployer.keypair: path to a fresh hot key made only for the deploy (a Ledger would have to approve ~500 buffer writes), never the devnet key; it holds ~4.2 SOL for an hour and loses all authority at handover
platform.inference / platform.buyback / platform.leftoverReceiver: wallets the multisig controls
platform.migrationThresholdSol and platform.openThresholdSol: real thresholds (open must be below migration)
platform.platformMint and platform.holdPerSlot: slot gating, or leave empty to keep it off

multisig._suggested: 2-of-3 members on hardware wallets, a time lock of at least 24 hours

runtime._note: The session key signs every agent trade. Generate it on the server that runs the runtime, keep it there, and give agents' owners only its public key.
